description:
Looking for a starter E-Moto that doesn't compromise on quality? Supermach SM62 Electric Off-Road Vehicle. Engineered for riders who want it all - power, agility, reliability, this high-performance E-Dirt Bike is built to dominate the toughest trails and track conditions at a competitive price.

Product Specifications

Why This Bike Stands Out

Blistering Acceleration: Go from 0 to 50 Km/h in under 1.6 seconds. Powered by a massive 16kW peak motor system throwing out an insane 530 N.m of torque, this bike delivers instant, arm-stretching electric power.

Premium Samsung Power Cell: Equipped with a heavy-duty 74V 50Ah Samsung 21700 NCM Lithium battery managed by an intelligent Smart BMS. Enjoy a massive range of up to 110 Km on a single charge.

Rapid 3-Hour Charging: Don’t spend all day plugged into a wall. The high-output 15A charger takes you from empty to trail-ready in just 3 hours.

Fully Weatherproofed (IP67): Built to conquer mud, rain, and deep puddles. The motor, battery pack, FOC controller, and LCD display all feature a certified IP67 waterproof rating.

Race-Grade "FAST" Suspension: Dominate rough terrain with fully adjustable front and rear compression and recovery damping. Features a generous 200mm front travel length and forged CNC components for pro-level durability.

Smart NFC Keyless Ignition: Say goodbye to traditional keys. Tap and go with secure NFC smart locking, paired with a crisp, crystal-clear TFT LCD instrument panel keeping track of all your live ride metrics.

Customizable Regenerative Braking: Choose your style of riding on the fly with a 4-level manual adjustment Energy Regeneration system that feeds power back into the battery every time you slow down

components.description: Front & Rear 220mm Disc Brakes with DOT oil tubes
74V 50Ah Samsung 21700 NCM Lithium Battery with BMS
Manual adjustment (Levels I, II, III, IV)
